title: Advanced Data Structures and Algorithms: Main Exam, 20 August 2021
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Define the term data structures.
Differentiate between data abstraction and data types.
Discuss why the study of data structures is important.
Differentiate between Θ-notation (same order) and O-notation (upper bound) in the analysis of algorithms.
Describe algorithm analysis and name two interpretations of the upper bound.
Differentiate between a singly linked list and a doubly linked list.
Describe any THREE application areas of graphs.
Describe algorithm analysis and name two interpretations of the upper bound.
Briefly describe any three steps for solving algorithm design questions.
Describe any two functions that are found in any greedy algorithm.
Describe the concept of the queue ADT and write algorithms to implement the initialization, enqueue and dequeue operations on a queue.
Explain the difference between Kruskal's algorithm and Prim's algorithm.
Describe depth-first search in algorithms.
Describe any four application areas of graph theory.
Define the following terms as used in the analysis of algorithms.
Euler circuit
Complete graph
Describe the structure of a greedy algorithm.
Using an example, write an algorithm that illustrates the following time complexities.
O(n)
O(n²)
Discuss two main areas of application for breadth-first search.
Discuss the searching problem and state any two searching approaches.
Using a real life situation, explain how the activity selection problem can be useful. Use pseudo code to explain your answer.
Explain the difference between a forward edge and a back edge in a graph algorithm.
Differentiate between a recursive algorithm and a recursive procedure.

Design a car renting system, including reserving a car, checking in and checking out. Consider all the cases: reserve a car, then check out successfully; reserve a car, but the car is sold out before you check out.
